'''Outpost Shear''' was an outpost that served as a defensive position for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]]-allied [[Jabiimi Nationalists]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]]. The outpost was the third position captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces after [[Camp Aurek/Legends|Camp Aurek]] and [[Point Down]] in the second [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of the [[Battle of Jabiim]].

==History==
{{Quote|This is the third defensive position we've taken this week and still no battle droids.|Alpha-17|<ref name="Republic 55" />}}
Outpost Shear served as a defensive position for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]]-allied [[Jabiimi Nationalists]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In their pursuit of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Alto Stratus]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces captured [[Camp Aurek/Legends|Camp Aurek]] and [[Point Down]] in the second [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of the [[Battle of Jabiim]].<ref name="HNN 14:9:01" />

In the same week,<ref name="HNN 14:9:01" /> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]],<ref name="Republic 55" /> his [[First Lieutenant/Legends|First Lieutenant]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]],<ref name="Republic 55 Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/12-201/Star-Wars-Republic-55The-Battle-of-Jabiim-Part-1-of-4|text=Star Wars: Republic #55 The Battle of Jabiim (Part 1 of 4)}}</ref> and [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]] led an attack on the Outpost Shear using the first-generation [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]], [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]], and [[All Terrain Experimental Transport]]s. As they overran the main emplacement, Alpha-17 suggested to Kenobi to flank the enemy to prevent their retreat.<ref name="Republic 55" /> Not prepared for the savagery of the fighting at Jabiim,<ref name="FF 125">{{FactFile|125|JAB 1-2|Battle of Jabiim}}</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sirrus]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Aubrie Wyn]], one of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] best [[Jedi healer/Legends|healers]], joined the advance at the Outpost Shear looking for General Kenobi. On her Master's motion, Wyn [[Force healing/Legends|healed]] a [[Unidentified Jabiimi soldier 1|wounded Nationalist soldier]],<ref name="Republic 55" /> which left her wondering if the Jedi were soldiers or doctors.<ref name="FF 125" />

On Kenobi's orders, Padawans [[Kass Tod]] and [[Mak Lotor]] of the so-called [[Padawan Pack]] ambushed the retreating soldiers as they fled along the flanks of the main column of the Republic army.<ref name="Republic 55" /> Within [[Standard day/Legends|days]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the outpost was captured, and Alpha-17 intended to interrogate the prisoners on Stratus' whereabouts, while Obi-Wan Kenobi ordered to regroup at their camp.<ref name="Republic 55" />

At one point, a [[HoloNet News Core Edition]] report on the Separatist [[Battle of Shelter Base|attack]] on the [[Shelter Base]] was transmitted from the base. The [[HoloNet News/Legends|news]] report mentioned that attack happened after Republic captured three Separatist defensive positions, including Outpost Shear.<ref name="HNN 14:9:01" />

==Behind the scenes==
Outpost Shear first appeared in the [[2003]] comic book [[Republic 55|''Republic'' 55]], written by [[W. Haden Blackman]] and pencilled by [[Brian Ching]].<ref name="Republic 55" /> It was first identified in "[[Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:9:01]]," an [[in-universe]] [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] report written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 69|sixty-ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="HNN 14:9:01" /> on [[July]] [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/06/news20030620.html|text=Clone War Details in ''Insider'' #69}}</ref>
